title: Environmental and industrial impacts of Cr(VI) in wastewater: high performance removal efficiency using novel ZIF-8 MOFs doped with cesium
content:

Omnia I. Ali, Sheta M. Sheta, Eman A. Elmenofy, A. T. Kandil, Said M. El-Sheikh
Water often contains chromium, one of the most dangerous heavy metal pollutants to the environment and human health, even at low levels. Development of novel adsorbent material for removing the Cr(VI) ions from wastewater is hot topic research area.
